summary: Tested SCORM export MongoDB asset persistence fix. All 11 backend tests passed and frontend UI verification confirmed SCORM export works correctly with slide images included in ZIP package.

✅ Backend: GET /api/ returns Scormify API message
✅ Backend: GET /api/projects returns 4+ projects
✅ Backend: GET /api/projects/57d237b2-3636-4ea8-a306-bede62e4fe23 (NR01) returns project with 3 slides
✅ Backend: Asset serving - slide_001.png, slide_002.png, slide_003.png all return 200
✅ Backend: Nonexistent asset returns 404
✅ Backend: Asset serving is consistent across multiple requests
✅ Backend: POST /api/course/{project_id}/export-scorm returns downloadUrl
✅ Backend: SCORM ZIP contains assets/slide_001.png, slide_002.png, slide_003.png
✅ Backend: SCORM package has valid SCORM 1.2 structure (imsmanifest.xml, index.html, course.json)

scorm_export_with_mongodb_fallback.description: SCORM exports for projects imported via ConvertAPI now include slide images in ZIP package. MongoDB asset persistence stores assets as backup and restores them during SCORM export when local files are missing.
key_files_verified: server.py lines 1316-1337: serve_asset endpoint with MongoDB fallback
services/scorm_exporter.py lines 181-193: Asset copying with MongoDB restore
services/ppt_image_parser.py lines 331-342: ConvertAPI images stored in MongoDB

projects_appearing_after_login.description: Projects appear correctly on dashboard after login. axios.defaults.withCredentials = true in ProjectContext.jsx ensures cookies are sent with requests.

critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB asset persistence is well-implemented with base64 encoding for binary assets
Asset serving endpoint has proper fallback to MongoDB when local file is missing
SCORM exporter correctly restores missing assets from MongoDB before packaging
axios withCredentials configuration properly fixes session cookie handling
seed_data_creation: Used existing project NR01 (57d237b2-3636-4ea8-a306-bede62e4fe23) with ConvertAPI-imported slides (slide_001.png, slide_002.png, slide_003.png)
context_for_next_testing_agent: SCORM export MongoDB asset persistence fix is VERIFIED WORKING. Test project NR01 (57d237b2-3636-4ea8-a306-bede62e4fe23) has 3 ConvertAPI-imported slides. SCORM export endpoint is POST /api/course/{project_id}/export-scorm. Asset serving endpoint /api/projects/{id}/assets/{filename} falls back to MongoDB when local file is missing. P0 bug (projects not appearing after login) is also FIXED via axios withCredentials in ProjectContext.jsx.
